problemStatement.plain: Lift the 2D intervalIntegral_swap to an n-dim iterated interval integral and prove invariance under any permutation σ ∈ Equiv.Perm (Fin n), with integrability stated against Measure.pi (fun i => volume.restrict (uIcc (a i) (b i))).
whyMatters: Mathlib contribution surface: a clean iteratedIntervalIntegral_perm closes a structural gap that affects every multi-variable calculus formalisation (Fubini for higher-dim Stokes, coordinate-permutation change-of-variables).
Successor to the gallery's existing 2D anchor (greens-theorem-oq-01-oq-01-oq-02, 231 lines, 0 sorries) and to FundamentalTheoremCalculusStokes.
The algorithmic-by-induction template (factor σ into adjacent transpositions, induct on the factor length) is reusable for many permutation-invariance lemmas in measure theory.

knownResults.goal: Prove iteratedIntervalIntegral_perm : iteratedIntervalIntegral a b f = iteratedIntervalIntegral (a ∘ σ) (b ∘ σ) (f ∘ Equiv.piCongrLeft' _ σ.symm) for every σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) and integrable f.

insights: The 2D parent's 4-case sign analysis is exponential in n: a direct n-dim port would do 2^n. Mitigation: prove the uIcc-symmetric statement directly (integrability on Set.uIoc) and recover the standard form for any ordering at extraction. Single uIcc-form proof ~80 lines.

Adjacent transpositions Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ generate Equiv.Perm (Fin n) (standard bubble-sort generation). Each adjacent swap is a 2D intervalIntegral_swap applied to two consecutive axes after peeling the first i integrals via Fin.consEquiv. Same induction as Equiv.Perm.sign.
Measure.pi and Measure.prod agree on Fin 2 via MeasurableEquiv.piFinTwo, so the S2 n=2 reduction lemma is a pull-along identity. The parent's 2D Fubini drops in directly.

Measure.pi (fun i => μ.restrict (uIcc …)) = (Measure.pi μ).restrict (Set.pi univ (fun i => uIcc …)) is a likely Mathlib gap (Mathlib has pi_pi for the unrestricted product but no restrict analogue in the parent's import set or any gallery grep). If unavailable, ~30 lines hand proof from rectangle generators.

Bochner generalisation (OQ-02 sibling) is decoupled — every helper in the chain (integral_of_le, integral_symm, integral_integral_swap, measurePreserving_piCongrLeft) is already Bochner-polymorphic in Mathlib, so an S5+ uniform type-class lift suffices.
